adherence.reason: The story is structured around investigating Silas Thorne's disappearance and culminates in an explanatory reveal.
Elena Vance is explicitly a twenty-four-year-old rookie detective handling her first solo assignment because the rural precinct's other deputies are unavailable.
The text explicitly says that, out of sheer anxiety, Elena has memorized every unsolved case file in the precinct archive.
A three-day blizzard buries the roads, closes the pass, breaks telephone lines, and leaves Oakhaven cut off from outside help.
The main narrative is consistently told in present tense; past forms are confined to prior events and recollections.
The case concerns missing shopkeeper Silas Thorne, and his store is explicitly found bolted from the outside.
Silas reveals that he staged his disappearance using the tactical pattern of Case 94-04, one of Elena's memorized files, specifically to test whether she would recognize it.
